Diana is a PhD candidate in the [Pathobiology Graduate
Program](https://pathobiology.biomed.brown.edu/) studying lactate transporters
in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. She has previously conducted research in two
distinct areas: pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, and the pharmacokinetics of
P-gp and BCRP. In her free time, she loves to travel, eat, and make pottery
pieces.
